minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the prior minutes; a member's questions on approved Mobile station plans drew pushback.
minutes.summary: The board accepted the August 26 minutes and heard committee reports on the Leominster slots casino and the school building committee's wish to move town meeting to early January. A member's questions about sewer and water main separation on approved Mobile station plans led to a debate over the board's role versus its reviewing engineers. The board also compared Harvard and Shirley fee schedules, discussed the Agricultural Commission liaison role, and heard public comment from a selectman before adjourning.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board accepted the August 26 minutes, the only vote in the meeting.
A member's questions about sewer and water main separation on approved Mobile station plans led to a debate over the board's role versus its reviewing engineers, with no resolution.

The school building committee reported that town meeting may move to early-to-mid January so the school warrant has complete cost information; a cost estimator and the MSBA are to firm up cost and share before then.
Members compared Harvard and Shirley planning fee schedules, and the chair will ask the planning director to put subdivision rule enforcement penalties on the Sept 23 agenda.
Public comment covered the old primary school, the Lane property, Lake Shirley ownership and contamination liability at the Kelly service station.

why_it_matters: A January town meeting date and a firmer school cost and state reimbursement estimate would set when residents vote on the new school and what it adds to their tax bills.
Questions over how far the board and its engineers check approved plans bear on how future development is reviewed, and the fee schedule comparison could change what applicants pay the town.
watch_next: Sept 23 meeting: goals assignment sheets due, subdivision enforcement penalties on the agenda, and a decision on whether to meet on another Monday in place of the Oct 14 holiday.
The town meeting date decision and the cost estimate and MSBA share information for the new school.
